notes: Completed the 2026-09-07 editorial scan and published one new Daily Brief. OpenAI's September 6 research report says it has reached the automated research intern milestone it announced last year: under OpenAI's definition, agents can now complete well-defined research tasks under human direction that would take a skilled researcher a few days. OpenAI also reports that by mid-August its research organization was using 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday, with agent use correlated with more code and experiments, while more than half of successful 4-8 hour tasks still required at least one human intervention. Those measurements are vendor-run and are presented as such; the durable signal is that frontier-lab R&D itself is becoming an agentic workflow and OpenAI is publicly targeting an automated AI researcher by March 2028. The September 7 GPT-6 Astra launch was deduplicated against AI Compass's existing Astra Critical-cyber-threshold coverage because the underlying model and governance change are already represented. Reuters reporting on Taiwan's chip diplomacy scored Worth knowing as an infrastructure/geopolitical signal but did not justify a reader-facing AI brief today. Reported U.S.-China AI safety talks remain Watch because official confirmation remains contested. Additional Reuters/OpenAI discussion of the German wiki incident was deduplicated against the existing OpenAI-Hugging Face incident analysis and the September 6 no-publish decision. No rumours, unsupported rankings or unverified pricing were published.
